subject: Rename ValkeyModule_DefragModuleString to ValkeyModule_DefragValkeyModuleString (#243)
reason: This is a cosmetic rename of a module-API symbol (ValkeyModule_DefragModuleString -> ValkeyModule_DefragValkeyModuleString) in module.c, redismodule.h and valkeymodule.h, with no change to the function body or behavior. The registered API name only has to agree between a module and the server built from the same commit, and the fuzzer only ever pairs matched module+server builds, so the renamed path behaves identically on the change and its parent. No compared sequence or fault run could observe a difference, so no scenario is warranted.
